sn22.88:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2
sn22.88:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Assaji Kassapakārāme viharati ābhādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || || 3
sn22.88:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā Assaji upaṭṭhāke āmantesi || ||
sn22.88:1.4: Etha tumhe āvuso yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamatha || upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatha ||
sn22.88:1.5: Assaji bhante bhikkhu ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno ||
sn22.88:1.8: Sādhu kira bhante Bhagavā yena Assaji bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampam upādāyāti || || 4
sn22.88:1.9: Evam āvuso ti te bhikkhū āyasmato Assajissa paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 5 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn22.88:1.11: Sādhu kira bhante Bhagavā yena Assaji bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampam upādāyāti || ||
sn22.88:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Assaji tenupasaṅkami || || 7
sn22.88:2.2: Addasā kho āyasmā Assaji Bhagavantaṃ dūrato āgacchantaṃ ||
sn22.88:2.4: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmato Assajissa etad avoca || ||
sn22.88:2.5: Alam Assaji mā tvaṃ mañcake samadhosi ||
sn22.88:2.7: Nisīdi Bhagavā paññatte āsane || nisajja kho Bhagavā āyasmantam Assajim etad avoca || ||
sn22.88:2.8: Kacci te Assaji khamaniyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ || la || paṭikkamosānam paññāyati no abhikkamo ti || || 10
sn22.88:3.1: Na me bhante khamanīyaṃ || la || abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo ti || || 11
sn22.88:3.2: Kacci te Assaji na kiñci kukkuccaṃ na koci vippaṭisāro ti || ||
sn22.88:3.3: Taggha me bhante anappakaṃ kukkuccam anappako vippaṭisārotī || || 12
sn22.88:3.4: Kacci pana taṃ Assaji attā sīlato na upavadatīti || ||
sn22.88:3.5: Na kho mam bhante attā sīlato upavadatīti || || 13
sn22.88:3.6: No ce kira tam Assaji attā sīlato upavadati atha kiñca te kukkuccaṃ ko ca vippaṭisāro ti || ||
sn22.88:3.7: Pubbe khvāham bhante gelaññaṃ passambhetvā passambhetvā kāyasaṅkhāre vippatisārī viharāmi || so taṃ samādhiṃ na paṭilabhāmi ||
sn22.88:3.8: tassa mayham bhante taṃ samādhim appaṭilabhato evaṃ hoti
sn22.88:3.10: Ye te Assaji samaṇabrāhmaṇā samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññā tesan taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhataṃ evaṃ hoti
sn22.88:4.8: So sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati sā aniccāti pajānāti || anajjhositā ti pajānāti || anabhinanditāti pajānāti || || Dukkhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati sā aniccāti pajānāti || || anajjhositāti pajānāti || anabhinanditā ti pajānāti || ||
sn22.88:4.9: Adukkham asukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati sā aniccā ti pajānāti || la ||
sn22.88:4.11: So sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati || || Dukkhaṃ
sn22.88:4.12: ce vedanaṃ vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati || || Adukkham
sn22.88:4.13: asukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati || || 24
sn22.88:4.14: So kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti || || Jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti || ||
sn22.88:4.15: Kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantīti pajānāti || || 25
sn22.88:5.1: Seyyathāpi Assaji telañca paṭicca vaṭṭiṃ ce paṭicca telapadīpo jhāyeyya ||
sn22.88:5.2: tasseva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā anāhāro nibbāyeyya || ||
sn22.88:5.3: Evam eva kho Assaji bhikkhu kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti || jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti || ||
sn22.88:5.4: Kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantīti pajānātīti || || 1
